purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in 2013, intended to feed flight-delay and weather-correlation analytics joining on station and hour.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to combine with flight-level data; treat wind_gust and pressure as frequently or occasionally null and filter or handle them deliberately rather than assuming completeness, since no values were imputed.
limitations: wind_gust is missing in 74.55% of rows (9702/13014) and pressure in 11.50% (1496/13014); wind_dir (1.68%) and wind_speed (0.015%) have minor null rates. duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 so no row-level deduplication was required, and the origin/time_hour grain is a close but not exact match to row_count (13014 vs. ~13023 implied by distinct counts) and should be validated against the warehouse before approval.
